correctness.rationale: For every field, direct substitutions into the weightzero RB identity prove P(a+v)=au+Lv with L²=0 and 2Lu=0; the converse is checked for general a,b,v,w. The exact rank-r count follows from choosing image U, kernel K containing U and an isomorphism V/K→U. P²(1)=Lu gives exact index-three count. For fixed even prime power, the centered-rank Gaussian formula admits a summable quadratic-exponential majorant, so dominated convergence establishes the sharp parity-dependent limit. The package verifier independently enumerates original identities in small prime-field cases and checks rank pairs.

value.rationale: The question is motivated by the Rota–Baxter index invariant and a known characteristic-zero classification of exactly the same local algebra. Characteristic two changes the maximal index from two to three for all radical dimensions at least two. The exact finite-field count, Jordan-rank partition and parity-sensitive asymptotic give complete natural operator statistics, including a nontrivial sharp law that index-three operators dominate. The same algebraic family and invariant are used throughout, rather than selecting arbitrary finite cases.
